SV EN FR

This is a translation of the Swedish lyrics and cannot be sung.

1.

When the Lord is my Shepherd, What can be lacking to me? All, all that I need, I shall receive from Him. In the green pastures of the Word He feeds His lambs, To the fresh springs of life He Himself leads them forth.

2.

And if from the flock strayed A single sheep, He will not Leave it behind in the desert A prey for the wolf, no; He seeks it in love, The faithful Saviour, And faithfully restores it To the right path again.

3.

The little lambs He shall carry And shelter at His breast, Bind up the wounded, Bring comfort to the sorrowful. In the good grazing land His flock may lie down, He richly blesses it Now and eternally.

4.

Thus I sing from my heart: The Lord is my Shepherd; With joy I follow Him The way that leads homeward. Only grace, yea, pure goodness Shall ever follow me, And I shall in His dwelling Dwell eternally.

Text: Anonym, 1916. Musik: St. Theodulph av Melchior Teschner, 1613. 7.6.7.6 D
